query: Marvell custom AI silicon revenue growth
normalized: ai custom growth marvell revenue silicon

output.content:
Marvell’s custom AI silicon business is transitioning from an approximately **$1.5 billion** business in FY2026 to a projected **more than $12 billion in FY2029**, implying it is expected to **more than triple versus FY2028** and exceed the company’s prior FY2029 target of $10 billion. [[1]] 

The stated FY2029 target implies FY2028 custom-silicon revenue below roughly **$4 billion** (because FY2029 is expected to be more than three times FY2028), so the plan entails a very steep ramp after FY2028 rather than a smooth, disclosed annual revenue series. [[1]] 

The near-term evidence of that ramp is indirect because Marvell does not separately disclose custom-silicon revenue in its quarterly headline results: Q1 FY2026 total revenue grew **63% year over year to $1.895 billion**, with management attributing momentum to rapid scaling of custom-silicon programs and electro-optics, while Q2 revenue grew **58% to $2.006 billion** and management again cited custom silicon as a principal growth driver. [[2]] [[3]] 

Management’s broader FY2028 framework calls for approximately **$20 billion** of total company revenue, up about **67% year over year**, including approximately **$18 billion** of data-center revenue; therefore, custom AI silicon is a major but not the only contributor, alongside interconnect, scale-up optics, switching, and other connectivity products. [[1]] 

The growth thesis rests on custom XPU and XPU-attach demand from hyperscalers: Marvell said it was shipping custom silicon to all four U.S. hyperscalers and had more than 50 opportunities across over 10 customers representing a $75 billion pipeline, although pipeline is not booked revenue. [[1]] [[4]] 

The principal execution risk is timing and concentration: the very large FY2029 target depends on individual hyperscaler design wins reaching volume production as planned, while Marvell’s June 2025 presentation characterized each custom XPU opportunity as multi-billion-dollar lifetime revenue but with an 18–24 month development cycle. [[4]]
